text:
"Why does Google keep rejecting my Business Profile posts?"

A plumber in Joondalup asked me this last week.

His post had his mobile number at the bottom and a link to his Facebook page.

That's exactly what Google now pulls posts for.

If your Google ads have been getting more clicks but fewer calls since September, open the search terms report.

Not your keywords. What people actually typed.

An electrician in Midland seeing "electrician jobs Perth" is paying for job hunters.

Your Google Business Profile is the shop window.
Your posts are the noticeboard.

Specials go on the noticeboard.

"50% OFF, RING NOW" across the front of the building doesn't look like a business. It looks like a garage sale.

Add a qualifying question before the booking step in your Facebook lead form.

"Which suburb are you in?"
"What do you need help with?"

Saves you driving to Mandurah for a job you were never going to quote on.

"Bob's Plumbing - Emergency Plumber Perth 24/7 Cheap"

That's not a business name. That's a keyword list.

It's one of the quickest ways to get your Google Business Profile suspended.

Use the name on your signage and your paperwork.

Twenty minute job for this week:

Read your Google Business Profile description like a stranger would.
Look at your last few posts.
Check your business name.

A rejected post is annoying. A suspended profile is a disaster.
